historical_commentary.text: Whatever specific search technique this note documented has likely been superseded by 4D's later native SQL engine (with its indexing and query capabilities) and full-text search options, or by modern set-based query commands, making the note's approach dated even though building custom search UX remains a common developer task today.
related_updates: 4D's later native SQL engine (v11 SQL, ~2007) and modern query/set commands provide more capable search foundations than were available in 2003
